comments.body: The full-block path in `bzlib.c:390-392` calls `BZ2_compressBlock` without `flush_RL`; `prepare_new_block` in `bzlib.c:117-126` leaves `state_in_ch` and `state_in_len` intact. `flush_RL` is called for flush/finish at `bzlib.c:384-386`. Please correct the claim that the compressor flushes the pending run when a block fills: it carries that run into the next block, where it is written wholly within that block. Cite the corrected source claim in the required `file.c:LINE` form.

STYLE.md requires C citations in the exact `file.c:LINE` or `file.c:FROM-TO` form. The bare line references `584`, `754`, and `799` here and on line 32, and `633`/`730`/`779` and `637`/`727`/`776` later in the module doc, are shorthand C citations. Please give each its `bzlib.c:` prefix.
